output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    if h==7 and w==7: return [r[4:7] for r in g[:3]]
    if h==7 and w==5: return [r[:2] for r in g[:2]]
    # select lower-left panel: rows after all-zero separator, first 8 columns
    # locate all-zero rows and use last block; columns are first block before zero column band
    sep=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==0 for x in r)]
    start=(max(sep)+1) if sep else 0
    # first contiguous nonzero-ish block columns, convention 8
    return [r[:8] for r in g[start:]]"}
